metadata.name: GoodTripPlus
metadata.description: [h1]GoodTripPlus[/h1] 将 [b]GoodTrip[/b] 融合进右上角的 [b]MiniMAPI[/b] 小地图！ 直接在小地图上选择房间并传送，在保留 GoodTrip 经典功能的同时，加入更多地图信息显示、实用功能与 Bug 修复。 [h2]主要功能[/h2] [list] [*]在 MiniMAPI 小地图上直接选择并传送至房间 [*]支持传送至未探索房间 [*]标记 Depths II 的 [b]Tinted Skull[/b] [*]标记 Mines II 的 [b]Yellow Rail Button[/b] [*]支持为传送设置时间惩罚 [/list] [h2]MiniMAPI 兼容[/h2] 兼容 MiniMAPI 的地图显示功能，包括： [list] [*]战斗时隐藏地图 [*]高亮初始房间 [*]高亮最远房间 [*]显示各房间到当前房间的距离 [/list] [h2]新增功能[/h2] [list] [*]集成 [b]Lazy Delver[/b] 的隐藏房候选位置标记 [*]在虚空层标记真正的 [b]精神错乱（Delirium）房间[/b] [*]显示地图边界，方便判断哪些方向已不可能生成更多房间 [/list] [h2]Bug 修复[/h2] [list] [*]修复使用控制台命令 [b]rewind[/b] 后 MiniMAPI 地图图标重置的问题 [*]修复虚空层中的地图错位问题：MiniMAPI 会将精神错乱的 2×2 房间按照原版地图显示为 1×1 房间，导致 GoodTrip MLX's Tweak 与 Lazy Delver 的光标、标记与地图整体错位。GoodTripPlus 已针对 MiniMAPI 的地图坐标重新适配 [/list] [h2]安装要求[/h2] [list] [*][b]必须安装：MiniMAPI[/b] [*]推荐安装：[b]Mod Config Menu[/b] [*][b]请勿与其他 GoodTrip Mod 同时启用！[/b] [/list] [h2]Credits[/h2] 感谢： [list] [*][b]GoodTrip[/b] — 原始地图传送 Mod [*][b]GoodTrip MLX's Tweak[/b] — GoodTripPlus 的主要开发基础 [*][b]Lazy Delver[/b] — 隐藏房候选位置标记 [/list] [hr][/hr] [h1]GoodTripPlus[/h1] [b]GoodTrip[/b], integrated directly into the [b]MiniMAPI[/b] minimap! Select rooms and teleport directly from the minimap while keeping the classic GoodTrip features, with additional map information, quality-of-life features, and bug fixes. [h2]Main Features[/h2] [list] [*]Select and teleport to rooms directly from the MiniMAPI minimap [*]Teleport to unexplored rooms [*]Mark the [b]Tinted Skull[/b] in Depths II [*]Mark the [b]Yellow Rail Button[/b] in Mines II [*]Optional time penalties for teleporting [/list] [h2]MiniMAPI Compatibility[/h2] Compatible with MiniMAPI's map display features, including: [list] [*]Hide the map during combat [*]Highlight the starting room [*]Highlight the furthest room [*]Display each room's distance from your current room [/list] [h2]New Features[/h2] [list] [*]Secret Room candidate markers from [b]Lazy Delver[/b] [*]Mark the actual [b]Delirium Room[/b] in The Void [*]Display map boundaries to show which directions can no longer contain additional rooms [/list] [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] [list] [*]Fixes MiniMAPI map icons being reset after using the [b]rewind[/b] console command [*]Fixes map misalignment in The Void: MiniMAPI renders Delirium's 2×2 room as a 1×1 room like the vanilla minimap, which previously caused the cursor and markers from GoodTrip MLX's Tweak and Lazy Delver to become misaligned. GoodTripPlus reprojects them to MiniMAPI's map coordinates [/list] [h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][b]Required: MiniMAPI[/b] [*]Recommended: [b]Mod Config Menu[/b] [*][b]Do NOT enable this mod together with other GoodTrip mods![/b] [/list] [h2]Credits[/h2] Special thanks to: [list] [*][b]GoodTrip[/b] — Original minimap teleport mod [*][b]GoodTrip MLX's Tweak[/b] — Main foundation of GoodTripPlus [*][b]Lazy Delver[/b] — Secret Room candidate markers [/list]
